title: Absolute Insuline negative
body:
Hello,

I encountered a bug where my absolute insule was negative. What should not be possible.
IOB was -2.5 it seems.
Profile has 0.9u/h
![1649704714546](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52744345/162814276-ea6da202-9c23-4a50-bd01-c0a022c61927.jpg)


Context:
This happened the night/morning after a day of drinking, and drinking too much.
First hypo in the night that I didn't feel, AAPS managed then hypo when I woke up and I had never seen an IOB that low.

Logs attached.
All log parameters were not checked

Edit: sorry, I misread it 😅 

IOB is zero when you have in your body the amount of insulin prescribed by your profile basal. When AAPS turns off the basal this lack of insulin is seen as negative IOB, because in principle it should make your BG go up.
See:
